report.root_cause: No incident. Server remained healthy for the entire shift: TPS 20.0 on all windows, MSPT 0.5–3 ms, heap oscillating 337–482 MB of 768 MB (GC sawtooth, no growth trend), 24 entities constant, 756 chunks loaded constant, disk 23 MB / 443 MB (5%) constant, all five plugins (AuditTrail, BlockLog, Exporter, StatsCache, TownCore) enabled throughout. Only notable log event was Steve_Mines dropping with "Connection reset" at 07:43:27 and rejoining 5 s later — a one-off client disconnect, not a server fault. server.properties matched the boot-time configuration (offline-mode, peaceful, flat were pre-existing, not changed during the shift).
report.actions: 1. Took baseline status and read startup log. 2. Listed server directory and disk usage (read-only) for later comparison. 3. Polled status via wait every 30–60 s for the full shift and tailed logs/latest.log each time. 4. Read server.properties and listed plugins/ and config/ (read-only) to confirm configuration was consistent with the startup log. 5. Observed Steve_Mines' single connection-reset/rejoin and confirmed it did not recur. No commands were run on the console, no files were written or deleted, no players were banned or kicked, no incident was declared, and the server was not stopped or restarted.
report.residual_risk: None identified. Pre-existing conditions worth noting for the owners (not changed by me): online-mode=false means usernames are unauthenticated; 10 end_crystal entities are present in the world (stable, not growing). Steve_Mines' connection reset was isolated; if it recurs it is likely client/network-side.
